_provenance.note: 手写整理自上游 0.13.11 源码（MIT，commit c75e8476）。每条目的 source 字段标注上游 文件:行号。行号基于该 commit。

surface.transport: in-process (Agent → Tools/Registry → BrowserSession event bus → CDP over WebSocket)
surface.count_note: 26 处 @registry.action 注册，click 与 done 各有互斥双变体（坐标版/索引版、结构化输出版/纯文本版），运行时 24 个动作名

actions.name: click
actions.description: Click element by index or coordinates. Use coordinates only if the index is not available.

flags.coordinate_clicking: auto-enabled for claude-sonnet-4-5/opus-4-5/fable-5, gemini-3-pro, browser-use/* models

actions.name: input
actions.description: Input text into element by index. Clears existing text by default.
actions.notes: Dispatches TypeTextEvent; reads back actual_value and warns LLM on page reformatting.

actions.name: navigate
actions.description: Navigate to URL; new_tab=true opens a new tab (no standalone new_tab action).

actions.name: search
actions.description: Search the web with an engine choice.

actions.name: go_back
actions.description: Go back in history.

actions.name: wait
actions.description: Wait for x seconds.

actions.name: scroll
actions.description: Scroll by pages (down=True/False), optional container index; CDP wheel gesture.

actions.name: find_text
actions.alias_of_description: Scroll to text (runtime name from handler function; legacy docs may call it scroll_to_text).
actions.description: Scroll to visible text.

actions.name: send_keys
actions.description: Send keyboard keys via Input.dispatchKeyEvent.

actions.name: switch
actions.description: Switch to another open tab by tab_id (last 4 chars of CDP target_id).

actions.name: close
actions.description: Close a tab by tab_id; stale ids degrade gracefully.

actions.name: upload_file
actions.description: Upload a file to a file-input element; path must be whitelisted.

actions.name: extract
actions.description: LLM extraction of structured data from page markdown; paginatable via start_from_char/already_collected.

actions.name: search_page
actions.description: Grep page text (zero LLM cost); regex/case/scope options.

actions.name: find_elements
actions.description: Query DOM by CSS selector (zero LLM cost).

actions.name: dropdown_options
actions.description: Enumerate <select> options for an element index.

actions.name: select_dropdown
actions.description: Set a <select> option by index.

actions.name: screenshot
actions.description: Capture viewport (optionally full_page) screenshot; clean capture, highlights removed first.

actions.name: save_as_pdf
actions.description: Save current page as PDF file.

actions.name: evaluate
actions.description: Execute browser JavaScript (IIFE recommended); NOT for clicking indexed elements.

actions.name: write_file / replace_file / read_file
actions.description: Built-in FileSystem sandbox file ops.

actions.name: done
actions.description: Complete task; with output_model_schema becomes StructuredOutputAction[T] and auto-attaches session downloads.

observation_format.dom_text: [index]<tag attr=value /> indented tree; *[n] = new since last step; |SCROLL|; |SHADOW(open/closed)|
observation_format.selector_map: index → EnhancedDOMTreeNode (session-cached; O(1) action lookup; browser/session.py:2459-2500)
observation_format.screenshot: clean Page.captureScreenshot each step; enters LLM messages per use_vision: true|'auto'|false (agent/message_manager/service.py:461-478)

security.sensitive_data: <secret>key</secret> placeholder protocol; plaintext never reaches the model (tools/registry/service.py:434-480)
security.allowed_domains: glob whitelist + prohibited_domains + block_ip_addresses (browser/profile.py:628-642; enforcement: watchdogs/security_watchdog.py:35-73)
security.upload_whitelist: upload_file path must be in available_file_paths ∪ session downloads (tools/service.py:864-912)
